candidats.titre: File:Ruinas de Santa Mariña Dozo, Cambados, Pontevedra, España, 2015-09-23, DD 34.jpg
candidats.description: Remains of the church of St Mariña Dozo, Cambados , Pontevedra , Spain. The gothic church was built in the 15th century over a former Romanesque church of the 12th century by order of María de Ulloa, mother of Alonso III Fonseca . In 1943 it was declared National Heritage Monument in Spain.
